_comment: Migration hints for `yama migrate`, and the ONLY place tool names appear
Yama's code never names a tool (repo rule 7): it asks for a capability and
the capability map supplies the name. A v3 config has no capability map, so
migrating one means guessing the map from the server id it used. That guess
is data, not logic, which is why it lives in this file rather than in src/.
Every entry is a STARTING POINT. `yama doctor --live` resolves each name
against what the server actually advertises and prints the real tool list
when one is wrong. Anything not inferred is left absent on purpose: an
absent capability is reported precisely at startup, while a wrong guess
fails at posting time, which is far later and far more confusing.
Match is by substring on the server id, longest key first.
